links.comparator_used: Source-only baseline (model trained at one site and applied at another without adaptation), and unsupervised domain adaptation methods that use no target labels
links.outcome: Cross-site AMR prediction performance from MALDI-TOF spectra (share of the domain gap closed)
links.effect: Fine-tuning with target-site labels closed 92%-97% of the domain gap; unsupervised DA yielded only 0%-6% improvement over source-only baselines; with 25% of target labels, 81%-94% of full supervised performance was recovered on cross-site scenarios
links.tradeoff: Requires collecting labeled samples at the target site, though a modest number (about 25% of target labels) suffices for competitive transfer methods
links.quote: The results demonstrate that simple fine-tuning with target-site labels closes 92%-97% of the domain gap and dominates all unsupervised DA methods, which yield only 0%-6% improvement over source-only baselines.

design_hint: local recalibration/fine-tuning with target-site labels before deployment
